name: lobby-control-room
description: Venue-side control room for SyncStart lobbies, reporting runs to Tournament Hub

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@lobby-control-room/syncstart-protocol && npm run build --workspace=@lobby-control-room/api && npm run build --workspace=@lobby-control-room/syncstart-simulator && npm run build --workspace=@lobby-control-room/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,frontend,simulator --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,gray "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:simulator"
scripts.dev:simulator: npm run build --workspace=@lobby-control-room/syncstart-simulator && npm run start --workspace=@lobby-control-room/syncstart-simulator
scripts.reset: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && npm run up
